name: chmod
description: Changes the read (r), write (w) and execute (x) permissions for the owner (u), the group (g) and others (o). The MODE is written in octal (755: each digit adds up r=4, w=2, x=1) or symbolically (u+x adds execute for the owner, go-w removes write from the group and others).

options.description: Applies the change to directories and everything in them.
Prints a message for each file processed.
Like -v, but only when a change actually happens.
Copies the permissions of another file instead of giving a MODE.

arguments.name: MODE
arguments.description: New permissions: octal (644, 755) or symbolic (u+x, go-w, a=r).

examples.explanation: Makes the script executable by its owner.
rwxr-xr-x: the owner can do everything, others can read and execute.
rw-------: a private key readable only by its owner (required by SSH).
Removes write from the group and others on a whole directory.

dangerNote: chmod 777 gives everyone every permission: it is almost always a bad idea. With -R, a mistake applies to the whole tree.
